We do the survey, the specification, the installation, the commissioning, the training and the service.

Hyperbaric, hypobaric and multiplace. A single chamber in a private house, a wellness floor in a hotel, a Premier League training ground, or a multiplace with airlock and medlock in a hospital. We run a clinic of our own in Bath.

We are the official HPO.TECH worldwide specialist.

HPO.TECH manufacture in Istanbul. The build slot, the interior specification, the certification file and the shipping date are set with them directly.

We work through the interior customisation with them, and see the vessels open before the cladding and the plant go on. Technical questions go to the engineers who build the pressure vessels.

The processSurvey to service, and after
01

Survey

A floor plan and a few photographs start it. A surveyor comes to the building, measures, and reports on the slab, the route, the services and the room.

02

Specification

One document: model, pressure, seat count, footprint, floor loading, plant schedule and the electrical and ventilation requirement.

03

Coordination

We work to your team, not around it. The structural engineer gets the loads, the M and E consultant gets the 7 kW and the 750 l/min, the contractor gets the programme.

04

Manufacture

A build slot at the factory in Istanbul, the interior specification set, and the vessel inspected before it ships. Every chamber we install is covered by the manufacturer’s EU MDR certification.

05

Delivery and installation

Modules through an 800 mm door, positioned, assembled and connected to plant sited within 15 m. Programmed around the building rather than the other way round.

06

Commissioning

Pressure test, leak test, gas analysis, alarm and control verification, against the manufacturer’s written procedure. Nothing is handed over until every one of them passes.

07

Operator training

To operator sign-off, under the International Board of Undersea Medicine. Delivered by people who run a chamber daily: emergency procedure, ear clearing, contraindications, what to do when a client is uncomfortable at depth.

08

Service and record

Scheduled servicing, parts, and the certification file kept current for the life of the system. A chamber out of certification is a chamber out of use.
